items.text: So glad to see the $2.5m for the White House Conference on Food, Nutrition, Health & Hunger in the new government spending package that @POTUS signed into law this week! I’m honored to work alongside a fearsome champion in @RepMcGovern. Lets #EndHungerNow!

Without it, we put the health of babies at risk. Abbott Nutrition, the company whose massive product recall exacerbated this crisis, is one of just four companies that control nearly 90% of the U.S. formula supply. 2/3

Americans were blindsided when Abbott Nutrition initiated a recall YEARS after consumers made safety complaints about their product. By leaving out safety and health complaints, we risk rewarding companies for practices that could endanger the public and harm investors. 2/2
Learn the signs and symptoms and info on vaccinations. https://t.co/msJzMmmP0J 2/2

It’s #WorldHepatitisDay & as Co-Chairs of the Congressional #Hepatitis Caucus, @RepHankJohnson & I continue to raise awareness about prevention, screening & treatment of this silent killer, & underscore the need for doing everything possible to finally eliminate this disease. 1/2

Glad to see Amb. Lipstadt speak out strongly against the outrageous antisemitic and anti-Israel remarks made by a COI commissioner at @UN_HRC. We must address the HRC’s biased treatment of Israel.  (2/2)

#SNAP benefits were designed to provide nutrition aid to families in need. But benefits in #NYC and around the country are being stolen. That's why I & @NydiaVelazquez are calling on @SecVilsack to replace these stolen benefits & provide guidance on how to combat this problem. https://t.co/jSMEVj9BxJ

Proud to work with my fellow Co-Chair @RepHankJohnson in urging @HHSGov to designate Sept. 9 as National African Immigrant and Refugee HIV/AIDS and Hepatitis Awareness Day (#NAIRHHADay) to encourage treatment & vaccination among immigrant and refugee communities.

Great to be with amazing New Yorkers at the first White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health in over 50 years. No American should have to choose between feeding themselves and paying for other necessities. Today we are building the movement to #EndHungerNow. 1/2 https://t.co/Ji8pm8xa55

I’m always glad to visit @SelfhelpNY’s Austin Street Senior Center in #ForestHills. Recently, I secured $15,000 for Selfhelp, which also has locations in #Flushing, #Bayside and #Maspeth, so that it can provide nutrition and emotional wellness activities to #Queens seniors. https://t.co/414tPkdZV5

#NYC Starbucks workers are striking today & recently a Starbucks in #Maspeth, Queens became the third in #NYC to file a petition for unionization. I am proud to continue my support of workers seeking fair treatment and compensation. #RedCupRebellion

Free COVID-19 testing and treatment continues to be available to New Yorkers including free at-home test kits. Visit https://t.co/Qw6LyzqDgT to see locations of testing sites, info on Mobile Test to Treat units, and where you can pick up an at-home test kit.

Free COVID-19 testing and treatment continues to be available to New Yorkers including free at-home test kits. Visit https://t.co/dDImSlo9ET to see locations of testing sites, info on Mobile Test to Treat units, and where you can pick up an at-home test kit.

Hepatitis C is preventable, & those incarcerated shouldn't be denied access to life saving medication & left to suffer. As Co-Chair of the Hepatitis Caucus, I am committed to broadening access to life-saving drugs, including for incarcerated individuals. https://t.co/VZz8q8BWAB

Great time speaking with seniors @SelfhelpNY's Older Adult Center in #Maspeth. Last year, I obtained federal funds for Selfhelp, which also has locations in #ForestHills, #Flushing and #Bayside so that it can provide nutrition and emotional wellness activities to local seniors. https://t.co/d3QofbLHZs

From great exercise and swimming classes to simply enjoying the water, I am excited to see those from our borough, especially our kids, families and seniors, using this wonderful Olympic-size pool. https://t.co/CvDrTRuHBL

Recently, a constituent from #Elmhurst received a date for her citizenship interview with @USCIS. But the appointment was scheduled for when she was out of the country for needed medical treatment. So, she asked my office for help with securing a new date. 1/2

#Tuberculosis is preventable, treatable, and curable. Nevertheless, it is the second leading infectious disease killer globally. 

On #WorldTBDay we raise awareness about this terrible disease and call for increased access to testing, treatment, and care. We can end TB!

It is always great to have @IBEWLocalUnion3 stop by & talk about the importance of Unions to the #Queens community & our nation as a whole. 

Unions are the backbone of our nation and have fearlessly championed fairness in wages and worker treatment for decades. #UnionStrong https://t.co/LSEc0MJX7c

I’m pleased to join @ChildCenterNY at the ribbon cutting for its Cohen Family Wellness Center in #Woodside. This new facility will help ensure needed and quality support for children, adolescents, families and adults in our communities. #Queens https://t.co/pdkhfHiyWh

Whether you live near an airport or miles away, peace of mind and a full night’s sleep is something everybody deserves. I spoke with @ASP about my bill to combat excessive airplane noise, the Quiet Communities Act.

Important training and resources being provided to #Queens residents at the mental health and wellness fair in #JacksonHeights held by the GPK Foundation, in collaboration with the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. https://t.co/o5uuN4yql6

Amazing meeting with @FoodBank4NYC to talk about the upcoming Farm Bill & my Hot Foods Act. 

Looking forward to ensuring critical nutrition programs like SNAP & WIC continue to help families, children, and the elderly. Great to have such staunch supporters of these programs. https://t.co/3cf4UCTptu

With respiratory illnesses on the rise in New York and across the U.S., it is critical to protect yourself from getting sick. From vaccinations to handwashing, @nycHealthy has helpful advice and information regarding prevention and treatment. https://t.co/vB9V6uM4JS

The Transcranial Magnetic Simulation (TMS) Suite helps treat patients with depression & other mental health concerns. TMS therapy is a procedure that uses magnetic fields to stimulate nerve cells in the brain to improve symptoms of depression.

Check it out👇 https://t.co/WMI0iEhQZo
